5170-6132-6559-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2267-5058-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2267-5058-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

301-728-5643.easyPrerequisites: You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-728-5643.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

1368-2033-2079-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-2033-2079-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

81-855-3099-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Corpsejack Menace and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2033-2266-3430.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} that is snow mana.
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by paying {1}{S}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2921-4452-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2921-4452-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

45-2341-2495.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Khalni Gem and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Khalni Gem and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Khalni Gem and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1483-6798-6972--112.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
1483-6798-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

3000-5670-6559.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-6559.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

509-662-2904-6499.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
509-662-2904-6499.notablePrerequisites:
The top card of your library has a higher mana value than the top cards of each opponent's library.
You have a way to choose one or more targets, as well as additional legal targets for that spell or ability.
509-662-2904-6499.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Psychic Battle to become an artifact.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Psychic Battle until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Choose any number of targets by any method.
Idris triggers, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library and changing the target(s) of the spell or ability to Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist and Idris trigger.
Resolve the Cephalid Illusionist trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library and changing the target(s) of the spell or ability to any other target.
Repeat from step 5.

11-2103-5131-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-2103-5131-6276.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Capture of Jingzhou, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-2103-5131-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1251-3259-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
1251-3259-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

372-1309-5895.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Salvager of Secrets exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
372-1309-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-6096.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-3480-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

1636-2319-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Mycologist has at least three spore counters on it.
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1636-2319-4312.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Mycologist.
Activate Mycologist's first ability by removing three spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana and you may target any creature using Vorel of the Hull Clade.
This combo also nets infinite spore counters on Mycologist if it has four or more spore counters to start the combo, and you may also optionally sacrifice the Saproling tokens to Mycologist's ability.

1981-1984-2773.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1981-1984-2773.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage to you equal to the creature's power, with your life total becoming no lower than 1 due to Angel's Grace.
Darien triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the damage dealt to you.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to you, with your life total becoming no lower than 1 due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat from step 3.

1462-1748-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1462-1748-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an additional creature.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Warehouse Tabby triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1597-2816.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Gyre Sage.
1597-2816.notablePrerequisites: Gyre Sage does not have summoning sickness, and has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1597-2816.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Gyre Sage by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

549-1558-3450.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have at least five poison counters.
549-1558-3450.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Phyrexian Swarmlord triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Phyrexian Insect creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Phyrexian Infects, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1329-1414-4222-4856.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Emry.
1329-1414-4222-4856.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping it and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Emry.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Brain Freeze.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve the all the Brain Freeze copies and Brain Freeze, milling any number of players for an arbitrarily large amount.

1700-4385-4587-4893.description:
All slivers have haste.
Tap a Sliver to generate {1}.
Use that mana to create a Sliver with Sliver Queen's ability.
Use the newly created Sliver to repeat the cycle.
